notes: This patch release requires Bifrost 0.15.1 or later and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.12.0, as rules 0.12.0 did. It removes the staged rules/bifrost.rust-codeql-security directory (#326) from the shipped rules root. That directory held CodeQL Rust endpoint catalogs but no manifest.json, and released Bifrost engines through 0.15.2 load every directory under a policy pack root as a pack, so rules 0.11.0 and 0.12.0 failed the whole default catalog with "configured policy source `bifrost.rust-codeql-security/manifest.json` does not exist". The catalogs registered no policy, so no policy, ID, finding or required capability changes from rules 0.12.0. They now live in research/rust-codeql-security, outside every release stream. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
